text:
Predicates:
LocatedIn(x, y) ::: x is located in y.
Place(x) ::: x is a place.
Premises:
Place(BarutinCove) ∧ Place(SnowIsland) ∧ Place(GreenwichIsland) ∧ Place(DeceptionIsland) ∧ Place(Antarctica) ::: Barutin Cove, Snow Island, Greenwich Island, Deception Island, and Antarctica are places.
LocatedIn(BarutinCove, SnowIsland) ::: Barutin Cove is located in Snow Island.
LocatedIn(SnowIsland, SouthShetlandIslands) ::: Snow Island is located in the South Shetland Islands.
LocatedIn(GreenwichIsland, SouthShetlandIslands) ::: Greenwich Island is located in the South Shetland Islands.
LocatedIn(DeceptionIsland, SouthShetlandIslands) ::: Deception Island is located in the South Shetland Islands.
LocatedIn(Antarctica, SouthShetlandIslands) ::: Antarctica is located in the South Shetland Islands.
∀x ∀y ∀z ((LocatedIn(x, y) ∧ LocatedIn(y, z)) → LocatedIn(x, z)) ::: If place A is located in place B and place B is located in place C, then place A is located in place C.
Conclusion:
¬LocatedIn(BarutinCove, Antarctica) ::: Barutin Cove is not located in Antarctica.
